name: Skill Link
description: Whenever this Pokémon rolls a d4 to determine if it strikes again for a move that can strike multiple times on a single attack roll (Fury Swipes, Double Slap, Water Shuriken, etc.), it strikes again on a result of 2, 3, or 4 on the d4.

updated.details: Instead of guaranteeing 2 strikes, each strike is made more likely.
